title: Industry insiders say new US export rules affect a broader range of chips, including SoCs used in consumer electronics, extending beyond advanced AI chips (Cheng Ting-Fang/Nikkei Asia)
summary: Cheng Ting-Fang / Nikkei Asia: Industry insiders say new US export rules affect a broader range of chips, including SoCs used in consumer electronics, extending beyond advanced AI chips — TAIPEI — Tighter U.S. export controls introduced Thursday are having a far broader impact on the global semiconductor supply chain …
